name: dpscreenocr
description: A program to recognize text on the screen

issues.title: Linux Wayland Support - Understanding Changes Needed
Create "Add languages" button that show instructions how to add

latest_release.name: v1.5.2
latest_release.body:
* Updated Tesseract to 5.5.4
* X11:
  * Significantly improved responsiveness of the selection rectangle, especially when selecting large areas
* Windows:
  * Fixed missing command-line output (e.g., "-help")
* New translations:
  * Portuguese
* Updated translations:
  * German
  * Spanish
* CMake:
  * Replaced DPSO_USE_DEFAULT_TESSERACT_DATA_PATH with DPSO_ENABLE_LANGUAGE_MANAGER

dpScreenOCR-1.5.2-MSYS2-pkgbuilds.zip contains PKGBUILD files for MSYS2 that were used to build custom versions of some libraries. See readme.txt in the archive for details.
